rationale: Single AML/CFT strategy PDF with dated action-plan milestones — strong evidence artifact, but the MFPT site is the monitorable parent.
Annual EU enlargement report hub for Kosovo — recurring, dated, highly predictive of AML/financial-regulation timing.
One EP resolution document; secondary confirmation only, low incremental value over the Commission report.
ARBK business/beneficial-ownership registry is a standalone registry with hard filing deadlines banks depend on for CDD.
One-off UNDP typologies PDF — useful background on FIU detection expectations, not a recurring signal source.
GLPS think tank publishes recurring independent AML monitoring — useful counterweight to official self-reporting.
BIRN/Kallxo is a continuously producing investigative outlet, fastest local signal on sanctions and enforcement changes.
EUR-Lex is the authoritative upstream for EU restrictive measures and the AML package Kosovo will align to.
Third-party mirror of Law 05/L-096, non-authoritative and redundant with the official gazette.
goAML reporting host is credential-gated; discovery value only, treat as an FIU sub-domain and clear access before use.
ATK is the primary fiscalization rule-maker publishing device specs, certification rules and dated taxpayer notices; failed fetch is soft only.
Live SEF certification portal — distinct application/licensing surface revealing certified-supplier entrants and windows.
EDI section of the ATK site; valuable release notices but covered by monitoring the ATK parent domain.
MFPT signs the administrative instructions binding fiscal-device use and parents both ATK and Customs.
Kosovo Customs governs import of POS/ATM hardware — standalone site, real cost and lead-time driver outside CBK remit.
A single 2017 Serbian-language legislation PDF; glossary value only and possibly stale/unreachable.
Fiscal-device conformance specification PDF — engineering-level requirement baseline, an artifact to archive rather than monitor.
Buletini Ekonomik gives sustained specialist coverage of the fiscal-register market and supplier concentration ATK does not narrate.
Single RFE/RL explainer article on a fiscal instruction; useful interpretation layer under the broader outlet.
Chamber of Commerce is the organised private-sector counterparty on fiscalization — early signal of deadline slippage and transitional relief.
Practitioner portal can surface effective dates early but credibility is modest; revisit after checking publication cadence.
Certified fiscal-solution vendor sites are direct competitor/partner intelligence on integration requirements and pricing.
CEFTA trade portal is an English index into Kosovo customs procedures — mine once for leads, reachability unconfirmed.
Consolidated ATK law/VAT handbooks are a convenient authoritative baseline text, an archived artifact not a feed.
General news wires give low-latency detection that an ATK/MFPT instruction or deadline landed; timing signal only, not legal text.
Scribd mirror of an administrative instruction — low credibility, redundant with GZK, and access-restricted by the host.
Competition authority rules on interchange, bank-fee and payment-scheme matters binding on banks and PSPs; failed fetch is soft only.
